page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Provisioned under a KVM hypervisor, the virtual machine provides 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include bundled local disk storage and contains no discrete GPU accelerators. Baseline network connectivity provides 3 Gbps of throughput. Hardware instruction sets include AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI, and cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Benchmark evaluations reveal balanced single-threaded execution alongside constrained multi-core metrics governed by the physical core count. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1569.0 and a multi-core score of 3355.0, matched by stress-ng results of 1881.08 in single-core and 3880.59 in multi-core testing. Memory bandwidth registers 28.84 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 23.66 GB/sec for writes. Single-threaded data handling remains stable, with gzip compression reaching 28.12 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression achieving 10.88 GB/sec. PassMark measurements yield a CPU mark of 5904.49 and a memory mark of 1509.91. For small-scale inference, prompt processing reaches 396.12 tokens per second and text generation produces 108.93 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model.

The ecs.c7t.xlarge delivers cost-efficient compute capacity for workloads that do not require high memory density or included local storage. Because all persistent storage must be attached via network volumes, users pay only for compute resources without unneeded local capacity. The instance is suited for front-end web serving, microservice architectures, API gateways, lightweight continuous integration runners, and small batch processing tasks.
